title: Power with recursion
description: Create a recursive method potencia(base, exponent) that calculates base^exponent without using Math.pow.
hints: The base case is when the exponent is 0, which returns 1
The recursive case multiplies the base by potencia(base, exp-1)
solutionExplanation: Base case: any number raised to 0 is 1. Recursive case: n^exp = n * n^(exp-1). long is used to avoid overflow.

title: Maximum with varargs
description: Create a method maximo that uses varargs to receive any number of integers and returns the maximum.
hints: The first element can be the initial candidate
If there are no arguments, return Integer.MIN_VALUE
solutionExplanation: The method uses varargs and iterates over the arguments comparing with the current maximum.

title: Recursive binary search
description: Implement recursive binary search on a sorted array that returns the index of the target or -1.
hints: Base case: bajo > alto means it does not exist
solutionExplanation: Binary search divides the space in half at each step. Complexity O(log n). The base case is bajo > alto (not found).
